label: Mountain
description: Mountain landforms as hero subjects — geology first: horns, aretes, moraines and the weather the peaks make for themselves.

items.name: matterhorn-pyramid
items.text: a glacial horn carved to a four-faced pyramid by the cirques gnawing every flank, its summit catching first alpenglow while the valleys below stay in blue shadow

items.name: knife-ridge
items.text: a knife-edge arete between two glacial cirques, snow cornices overhanging the leeward drop, cloud boiling up one face and pouring down the other

items.name: glacier-tongue
items.text: a crevassed glacier tongue pouring between dark buttresses, twin medial moraines striping the ice, late-summer melt exposing bands of older, bluer ice

items.name: dolomite-towers
items.text: pale dolomite towers rising sheer from green meadow benches, scree fans spilling from every gully, the last strips of June snow holding in the shaded chimneys

items.name: volcanic-cone
items.text: a dormant stratovolcano of textbook symmetry above an undercast cloud sea, spring snow held in the radial gullies so the whole cone reads as striped

items.name: karst-pinnacles
items.text: drowned tower-karst pinnacles rising from still jade water, each limestone spire undercut into a waist at the waterline and crowned with clinging green

items.name: highland-tors
items.text: weathered granite tors stacked like dropped masonry on a moorland ridge, rounded along their ancient joint lines, autumn heather rusting red around the outcrops

items.name: cloud-inversion
items.text: summits islanded above a valley-filling cloud inversion, the trapped undercast pouring through a low pass in slow motion like a tide between them

items.name: basalt-mesa
items.text: a flat-topped basalt mesa, its dark caprock lava flow shielding the soft banded sediments beneath, talus skirts running down to the plain

items.name: hanging-valley-falls
items.text: a hanging valley stranded high on the glacial trough wall, its stream leaping the lip in one free-falling ribbon past cliff-rooted pines

items.name: tablecloth-cloud
items.text: a flat-topped mountain pouring its white tablecloth cloud over the rim, evaporating exactly as fast as it falls

items.name: avalanche-plume
items.text: a spring powder avalanche blooming down a couloir, the airborne plume overtaking its own slide
